recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中成群的圓形至卵圓形細胞，細胞質充滿深紫色顆粒、細胞核位於中央且顏色較淡，符合肥大細胞（mast cells）聚集；部分細胞顆粒較少，為系統性肥大細胞增生症常見的非典型肥大細胞。
features: Cohesive clusters and sheets of medium to large round/oval cells
Cytoplasm packed with dense dark purple metachromatic granules
Central round to oval nuclei appearing paler than the granular cytoplasm
Some cells hypogranular with pale blue cytoplasm and fewer granules
Occasional spindled or irregular cell outlines at cluster edges
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear contains aggregates of numerous mast cells with abundant cytoplasm filled with dark purple metachromatic granules and central round to oval nuclei. A subset shows partial hypogranularity and irregular or elongated contours. Such mast cell aggregates are not seen in reactive marrows. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis; correlation with the biopsy (tryptase/CD117 aggregates, CD25/CD2 aberrancy), serum tryptase and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented or lobated nuclei with granules overlying the nucleus and are smaller, whereas mast cells have round central nuclei and do not form tight aggregates in blood.
Reactive mast cells are scattered singly, well granulated and round, without aggregates, spindling or CD25/CD2 expression.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and agranular basophilic cytoplasm.
